Name: I Got A Mail
Author: loopenbumble
Description:
Replaces the in-game mail opening sound with a mashup of Love Island's iconic "I've got a text!" and the AOL "You've got mail!" sounds.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url] to work.

[b]To install[/b]:
[list]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file
[*]Place the file "[CM] I GOT A MAIL" into your Mods folder
[*]Run the game with SMAPI
[/list]
Thanks to krazylegonxt for helping :)

Feel free to message if there are any issues or suggestions!

[I am aware of the issue where it replaces the sound in other instances, I'm working on it!]
